text:
alisa: Quick follow-up on the RFC for the sidecar strangulation — proposing a surgical, phased removal with a telemetry "fence" to avoid blind cutovers. Thinking feature-flagged routes + dual-write telemetry for a controlled rollback. Thoughts?

mike: Sounds good. Can you outline the failure modes you care about most? rollback hooks / automation?

alisa: Main failure modes: 1) auth token mismatch (sidecar did JWT->internal token), 2) sudden p95 latency regressions on hotpath, 3) cache-warmth/KV hit drops causing QPS spikes, 4) silent quality regressions for model requests. Rollback hooks: router traffic percentage + automated fallback to sidecar route.

sophia: +1 to phased approach. Proposed phases: 1) read-only shim (no writes to new path), 2) canary write-path at 10/50/100% with telemetry dual-writing, 3) full cutover + retire sidecar. Signals: error-rate, latency p95/p99, KV hit ratio, model quality sampling.

jamal: Observability fence details: - dual-write telemetry for 2w with sampling ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%), - shadow tracing so spans include both flows, - log tagging: "sidecar=legacy" / "sidecar=removed". Router fallback rule: if p95 > 120ms or errors > 1% for 5m, route back to legacy. We'll also set an alert on cache hit drop > 15%.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to prod-dedicated-1 (service/router) — tag: canary/sidecar-strangler — started 5m ago.

mike: Need a migration plan for tenant configs and token facade. The token shape is critical; either gateway issues internal token or keep a tiny token-adapter microservice. Also add a scheduled migration window and DB migration script with idempotent runs.

sophia: For the token facade option, recommend facade has a compatibility shim that accepts legacy tokens for 30 days. That buys us rollback safety while we rotate clients.

jamal: Also recommend automated chaos test: kill sidecar binary on a subset of instances post-canary to verify fallback + warmup behavior. I'll add that to the runbook.

alisa: Draft rollout playbook (high level): spike -> internal canary -> public canary (10% dual-write) -> ramp to 50% -> full -> wait 48h observe -> decomm. Checklists: unit/integration tests, e2e model quality eval, chaos run, infra capacity check, DB migration dry-run, telemetry dual-write verification. I'll own routing + rollout orchestration.

mike: Please add cost-regression monitoring (tokens/request, GPU utilization) and KV cache hit ratio to the checklist.

sophia: Also mark API contract changes (if any) and notify SDK teams. Add a doc for the token compatibility window and expected dates.

alisa: Will post RFC update + concrete checklist by EOD. tagging @sophia for prioritization and @jamal for telemetry runbook. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
